sources.supports: Biotin role in food-to-energy metabolism; limited evidence for hair/skin/nails claims; most people obtain enough; interference with laboratory tests including thyroid hormones.
50 vegetable capsules, D-biotin 5000 mcg per capsule, one per day.

Visually read official label: adults one capsule daily preferably at mealtime or practitioner direction, do not exceed directions. URL filename says iu but photographed label explicitly says micrograms.

duplicate_check: No biotin matches in curated/data or all-branch commit message history.
editorial_verdict: Not worth an indiscriminate trial for hair shedding; does not deny medically indicated supplementation.
